frontiers.title: Complete frozen native-MTP 32-token category holdouts
frontiers.question: Do the ordinary-text PW-0216 gains survive the already-frozen code, multilingual, and rare-route holdouts?
frontiers.whyItMatters: This determines whether the strongest complete-path gain broadens beyond its first untouched slice.
frontiers.cheapFalsifier: Run the frozen remaining holdouts under the PW-0216 protocol without changing prompts, thresholds, or arithmetic.

frontiers.title: Reduce native proposer embodiment cost
frontiers.question: Can proposal generation become materially cheaper while the source-checkpoint verifier remains the sole commit authority?
frontiers.whyItMatters: PW-0216 shows useful speculation, but proposal cost and verifier/storage traffic remain far from the 50 TPS target.
frontiers.cheapFalsifier: Predeclare one embodiment mechanism and measure its isolated proposal cost before a complete interleaved candidate/control run.
redLines: draft approximation must not commit output

frontiers.title: Attack dominant prefill and storage traffic
frontiers.question: Which mechanism can remove dominant full-path bytes or stalls after recent prefetch, transport, and packed-domain controls?
frontiers.whyItMatters: Current text delivery remains orders of magnitude below target and storage/prefill costs dominate several measured cuts.
frontiers.cheapFalsifier: Show that a named mechanism can affect a nontrivial share of complete wall time before implementing a new runtime path.
redLines: no theoretical bandwidth as achieved TPS

frontiers.title: Close accumulated parity and native modality gaps
frontiers.question: Can the bounded causal path pass accumulated hosted-reference parity and extend through native image, audio, video, and mixed inputs?
frontiers.whyItMatters: Full-capability near-equivalence is a completion gate independent of text throughput.
frontiers.cheapFalsifier: Add the next missing layer-local or modality fixture and stop on the first unexplained mismatch in the correctness ladder.
redLines: no text surrogate for native media
no parity claim without required logprobs

frontiers.title: Find a weight representation mechanism beyond the audited controls
frontiers.question: Is there a new representation mechanism that reduces executable traffic while surviving source-faithful and real-query controls?
frontiers.whyItMatters: The routed bank dominates capacity and traffic, but recent equal-budget candidates failed their fidelity or work gates.
frontiers.cheapFalsifier: State the premise changed relative to PW-0300--PW-0304 and test it on a real-query, equal-traffic control before training or kernel work.
redLines: modified weights must be named modified
